title: Find the thread across your experiences
excerpt: What are some common themes that thread between the work experiences?
note: Pamela Slim, quoted by Dorie Clark in How To Build Your Personal Brand And Your Body Of Work. This prototype adapts the article section; it is not based on a review of the complete book.
method_summary: Compare experiences for recurring contributions, lessons, or beliefs. Suggest one possible connecting theme, then let the person decide whether it fits.
limitations: A starting point for reflection, not a definitive personal brand. Different situations may suggest different themes. This is a source-informed exercise, not the author's own advice or endorsement.
